note: Critical findings require an assigned AUTH-SECURITY-OWNER identity. Finding lifecycle authority stays with Phases 10 and 11; this registry records acceptance, never state.
purpose: Sealed ACCEPTED_RISK records: explicit, narrow, artifact-bound, and expiring. Empty means no risk has been accepted. An acceptance never closes the underlying finding, is not NOT_AFFECTED, expires automatically at expires_at (an expired acceptance blocks authorization), and never transfers to a successor artifact.
